answer: If an agent bids below its optimal bid \( b^*_i \) in CIRCA, it results in less utility gained for the agent. Specifically, the agent's utility decays much quicker when bidding below \( b^*_i \) because they are (i) less likely to win the premium reward and (ii) at risk of losing the value from deployment if the bid does not reach the compliance price \( p_\epsilon \). Thus, deviating from the optimal bid leads to a decrease in utility for the agent.
